QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: guidedMinimumAltitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Minimum altitude for guided actions altitude slider.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: guidedMaximumAltitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Maximum altitude for guided actions altitude slider.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: alternateInstrumentPanel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Use Vertical Instrument Panel instead of the default one

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showAdditionalIndicatorsCompass
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show additional heading indicators on Compass

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showSimpleCameraControl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show controls for camera triggering using MAV_CMD_DO_DIGICAM_CONTROL.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showPhotoVideoControl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show photo/video control widget on fly view.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: If disabled, the photo/video control widget in the bottom right of the fly view will be hidden.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showObstacleDistanceOverlay
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show obstacle distance overlay on map and video.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: maxGoToLocationDistance
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Maximum distance allowed for Go To Location.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: updateHomePosition
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Send updated GCS' home position to autopilot in case of change of the home position

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: customActionDefinitions
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: File that defines custom actions to send connected vehicle

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showGuidedActionSlider
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: If enabled, a slider will be shown for guided actions like takeoff, altitude change, etc. If disabled, the action will use default values.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: disableStartMissionSlider
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, the slide-to-confirm dialog will not automatically pop up when a mission is ready to start or continue.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: autoLoadMissionOnConnect
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, QGC requests the mission from the vehicle on every connection. Disable to avoid slow mission downloads on connect; you can still trigger a manual download from the plan view.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showMissionOnMap
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show mission on Fly View map
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Master switch for displaying the mission on the Fly View map (polyline, waypoint markers, and direction arrows). Turn off to hide all mission visuals without losing the loaded mission.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showPhotoCaptureIndicators
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, small camera icons are drawn on the Fly View map at each photo capture location. Disable to reduce visual clutter or improve performance on long missions.
